whoItsFor: Developers and creators using Claude Code or Codex who want to turn their product pages and copy into a polished, editable promo video built with Remotion code rather than an AI video generator.
useCases: Make a launch or promo film for a product from its real screenshots and copy
Present a feature by picking shot recipe cards from the 150-shot library
Edit the delivered film in the Motion Workbench or export it as a JianYing draft

requirements.runtime: Node.js and npm, ffmpeg / ffprobe, uv (only for BGM beat analysis)
